nodes.label: src/main.js ES Module Entry
nodes.rationale: Plain ES modules loaded by the browser, with no bundler runtime beyond Vite, so the same page runs in the app's web view and in a dev browser.

nodes.label: Locked Mobile Viewport and Dark Scheme
nodes.rationale: user-scalable=no, maximum-scale=1 and viewport-fit=cover stop the page zooming and let it draw under the notch; color-scheme dark matches the app's fixed dark look.
